notes.title: Happy New Years
notes.content:
Hi, everebody! Happy New Year! Finally, a year later, You are the Pilot is ready to leave Early Access. This patch fix the latest critical bugs. The release is scheduled for January 19, 2024. After release, the price will be set $2. The support doesn't end there. Two free add-ons will be released throughout the year.

It's been a difficult year; development was hampered by constant travel and stress. Thanks to everyone who believed in me and the project! Thanks to everyone who left a review! Thanks for the reposts, likes and comments! Thank you to my wonderful wife for your love and support! Thanks to Aink and Mads for the wonderful music! Thanks to my friend Oleg for his help with translating the game into English, for shelter and support in a particularly difficult moment! I am writing this with tears in my eyes. All of you who took part in the development and who were directly involved in my life, only you did not let me break.

p.s. Sorry about my english.

notes.title: Gamepad support update
notes.content:
Oh! Hi, everybody!
I added support of gamepad. You can play with Xbox controller and Dualshock 4. The vibration also works on the Dual shock. I’ll add it to other gamepads later. It's hard because I can testing this only on Dualshock now. I hope to add Steamdeck support because I think that the game will feel good on portable. I fixed a lot of bugs and soft locks. Now you can complete all missions. The release is coming.

notes.title: Build or die!
notes.content:
Oh! Hi, everybody! I have two new modes for you! I invite you to compete with me in them. Beat the developer's record if you canːtmntleoː
DEATH GAME - survive as long as possible in the competition for survival. Dodge missiles and get 1 dollar for every second.
Building mission - build a skyscraper all the way to space. Get $100 for every floor you build.

notes.title: HOT UPDATE
B-day update!
notes.content:
Oh! Hi all! Happy birthday to me! Today I have a new update for you, dear friends!
I've added new jobs and a helmet system.
You can now find helmets in the game. The helmet has a margin of safety, and this saves the pilot's head.
The ambulance driver must quickly deliver patients to the hospital, otherwise they will come to carry the bodies to the cemetery.
Delivery has no time limit.
Enjoy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41519763/dccc2bccf2442cf739ea202754557949a4980a3e.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Roadmap changes.
notes.content:
Oh! Hi, everybody! April passed without updates, but in the coming months, a lot of updates will be available. I have made the decision to abandon the tomb storyline in favor of additional missions in the city. Taxi is ready, and it is great for playing. As soon as I finish the pizzeria, I will post a new update.
I took note of the complaints that the game is too hard. There will be ways to make your life easier. I will add different cars to the game with different characteristics of control, speed and durability. Also, helmets can now protect the pilot's head from an instant game over.
The ability to buy the goal will appear on the release.
After the release, the work will not stop. There are 3 additions in the plans, their implementation will depend on the interest of the players and on the number of copies sold.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41519763/c7691182f77bffe87f17866ba4bdd3f8260eb332.jpg[/img]
